allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

trace.description: Traceability links connecting this red-team analysis to related artifacts.

items.description: A traceability reference for the red-team analysis.

threats.description: Identified security threats with severity, mitigations, and traceability.

threat_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this threat.

description.description: Detailed description of the threat scenario.

vector.description: Attack vector or method by which the threat could be exploited.

target_ids.description: IDs of the APIs or components targeted by this threat.

items.description: A trace reference to an API or component targeted by this threat.

category.description: Security domain category: authentication, authorization, business logic, transport, or data privacy.

mitigations.description: List of mitigations that address this threat.

type.description: The artifact type that provides the mitigation.

id.description: Kebab-case ID of the mitigating artifact.

note.description: Additional context about how this mitigation addresses the threat.

items.description: A mitigation linking a spec artifact to this threat.

severity.description: Severity rating of the threat from low to critical.

risk_category_ref.description: Canonical reference for the risk category in the registry.

policy_ref.description: Canonical reference for the security policy governing this threat.

items.description: A single security threat with severity, mitigations, and targeted artifact IDs.

edge_cases.description: Edge cases identified during red-team analysis that may expose vulnerabilities.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this edge case.

description.description: Description of the edge case scenario.

trigger.description: Condition or action that triggers this edge case.

items.description: A single edge case with identifier, description, and optional trigger.
